integrity: Self-contained structural proof, with separate finite face-and-boundary verification. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to total three-cut complexes of wheels with two hub-spoke deletions, n>=6; neither arbitrary edge faults nor more deletions are covered. Novelty remains subject to unindexed literature. Finite verifier does not substitute for the unrestricted proof.
title: Two-spoke threshold for the total three-cut complex of a wheel
